To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the proteome is the sum total of the expressed protein complement encoded by the genome and (2) the proteome may provide the key to understanding the function of a particular gene.

(1) the proteome is the output code, not the input code; (2) proteome analysis is the key to understanding gene function; (3) proteome analysis can provide a ‘road map’ of the cell; (4) proteome analysis may be the most powerful tool for understanding the cell, and (5) proteome analysis has the potential to be the most powerful approach to the study of human disease.
